from pathlib import Path
import hashlib

nonce = 'PREDICTION_BUS_WSL_CANARY_20260929_E015'
p = Path('.runtime/bus_code_canary_20260929_e015.txt')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = nonce + '\n'
p.write_text(payload, encoding='utf-8')
readback = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert readback == payload
digest = hashlib.sha256(readback.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert len(digest) == 64
print(nonce + '=PASS')
print('READBACK_SHA256=' + digest)

notes: Harmless end-to-end GitHub command-bus -> project-executor -> WSL code execution canary. Exact PASS requires Python execution plus write/readback assertion.
